Commentary.Commentary: A big total on the board posted. The batsmen have done the job and now it's over to the Dutch bowlers to achieve a big win and boost the net run-rate. Do join us in a short while for the chase.

A quick interview with the Dutch openers. Ben Cooper says that he loves batting along side Max. O'Dowd then tells that they were not bothered about the run rate and just went with the flow. Reckons that it's their best batting show until now. On frowning after seeing Ryan ten Doeschate coming out to bat, Ben smiles and replies that he's a very quick runner between the wickets and pushes you hard. Max opines that pace off the ball and cliched T20 bowling - that's all their bowlers need to do.

It was a very ordinary bowling show by Bermuda. They lacked quality to create any pressure and leaked runs at a very quick rate. Their skipper rotated the bowlers but none managed to hold one end. Bermuda now have their backs to the wall and will have to bat out of their skins to overhaul this gigantic target.

Smashing show by the Orange team! They have amassed a total in excess of 200 for the first time in this format and this won't do any harm to their run-rate. Opting to bat, Ben Cooper and Max O'Dowd raised a 123-run stand to set the platform. They scored 58 each in quick time and then the batsmen who followed pressed on the accelerator. Ryan ten Doeschate and Colin Ackermann batted with a lot of intensity and pumped the Dutch total past the 200-run mark.
SIX! Finishes the innings with a big blow. Short in length on middle, Ackermann turns inside the crease and hammers it over square leg for a biggie. Netherlands finish on 206/3!
Physio comes out for the mandatory concussion check. All good with Scott Edwards.

Bang on the helmet! A delivery served in the line of the stumps. Edwards tried to play the reverse sweep but it took the top edge and smashed him on the back of the helmet. The extra protection came off and the ball ricocheted to point. The batsmen cross. 200 up for the Dutch!
Flighted delivery on middle, Edwards sweeps it towards fine leg. The batsmen get two runs.
FOUR! Nice improvisation. Flighted delivery on off, Edwards plays a reverse sweep over point for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Edwards looks to play the reverse sweep but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Edwards flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.

FOUR! 17 runs from the over and Netherlands are just 9 short of 200! Leverock pitches it up and outside off, Ackermann gives it the full whack of his bat and muscles it down to long on for a boundary.

FOUR! Once again Colin is cheeky with his shot to gather a boundary. He picks the line early, it's outside off and Ackermann immediately jumps across the stumps. After that, he brings out his paddle scoop to beat short fine leg.
Short delivery outside off, Ackermann cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Scott Edwards is the new man in.

OUT! That's a well-judged catch in the deep by Oronde Bascome! Leverock delivers a length ball outside off, probably a slower one, ten Doeschate tries to smash it across the line over the leg side but is early into his shot. It catches the top edge and flies straight down the ground. Oronde moves across to his right from long off, settles underneath it and then catches it over his head before going down.
Length delivery outside off, Ackermann plays it towards covers for a single.

FOUR! Innovation from Ackermann. He shuffles across the stumps to line up the length delivery served wide outside off and then he spoons it over short fine leg for a boundary. 50-run stand comes up in quick time!
WIDE! Bowls it outside the tramline, Ackermann leaves it alone.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Ackermann lets it go.

SIX! Tonk! Trott bowled a fabulous over until this delivery. He serves right in the slot for the batsman. Ten Doeschate clears his front leg and launches it into the stand at mid-wicket. 4-0-31-1, Rodney Trott has bowled out.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Ryan flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.

Flatter one wide outside off, ten Doeschate initially exposes all his stumps and then tries to get close to the delivery. Attempts for the slog sweep but it takes the inside edge and hits him on the pads.
Floated delivery on middle, Ryan flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up delivery on off, Ackermann looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ackermann looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Rodney Trott is back into the attack. 3-0-20-1 are his figures so far.
Nails the yorker at last. It's outside off and Ryan fails to dig it out. 12 from the over.
Pitches it up and outside off, ten Doeschate strokes it through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Half-tracker on middle, it's paddled to short fine leg for one.
FOUR! Edgy this time! Leverock continues to offer width outside off. Colin throws his bat at it and this time it runs off the outside edge to third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Once again there is width outside off and Ackermann gives it a good hit over covers. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
Width on offer outside off, it's steered through point for one.
Kamau Leverock returns into the attack. 2-0-14-0, so far.
Short delivery on off, Ryan cuts it through point. The batsmen cross ends. 13 runs have come from the over.
Full on middle, Ryan drives it through mid on. The batsmen get two runs. 150 up for Netherlands!
Tossed up on off, Ackermann drives it through covers for a run.
Full on middle, Ackermann drives it through mid on. The batsmen get two runs.
SIX! Amazing shot. Flighted delivery on middle, Ackermann lofts it over long on for a maximum. There was a fielder in the deep but he had no chance of catching that.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ryan flicks it through square leg for a run.
Bowling change. Dion Stovell to bowl his third over. So far he has conceded 12 runs.
Full on off, ten Doeschate drives it through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Ackermann drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Ryan plays it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Floated delivery on off, ten Doeschate plays a reverse sweep closely past the keeper to third man for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ackermann sweeps it towards square leg for a run.
Tossed up on off, Ackermann plays it to point.
Tossed up delivery on middle, ten Doeschate flicks it to mid-wicket. Superb over, just four runs and a wicket from it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Ackermann flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Colin Ackermann is the new man in.

OUT! Both the set batsmen dismissed in quick time! Trott fires in a flatter delivery in the line of the stumps. It's a slider which skids back into the left-hander and Cooper goes down on knee for the slog sweep. His bat swings early, the ball arrives late and the stumps are shattered. Fine knock by Cooper comes to an end and Bermuda are trying to gain some control in this match.
Floated delivery on middle, ten Doeschate flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cooper drives it towards mid on for a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, ten Doeschate drives it through mid off for a single.

Short delivery outside off, ten Doeschate makes room and cuts it towards point where the fielder tries to stop it but it goes through him. The batsmen get three runs. 13 runs and a wicket from the over.
No respite for Bermuda. Ryan ten Doeschate is the next batsman in and the stage is set for this star batsman to accelerate.

OUT! Fantastic catch at extra cover! Fuller in length and outside off, O'Dowd goes hard at it and hammers it uppishly through the line. O'Brien inside the ring throws himself to his right and catches the travelling ball. That's a superb effort. The century opening stand is broken and Bermuda would be feeling relieved.
SIX! That is huge! Flighted delivery on middle, O'Dowd powers it over long on for a maximum.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cooper flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Cooper drives it through mid off. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on middle, O'Dowd drives it through mid on for a single.
Rawlins is back into the attack. 1-0-14-0 his figures so far.
Slightly short and outside off, O'Dowd moves back and steers it behind backward point for one. 13 from the over!
Sliding down the leg side, Ben fails to flick and it goes off his pads to the on side. They cross for a leg bye.
Fuller and outside off, Cooper threads his drive through covers and returns for the second run.

FOUR! Another smashing shot by Ben Cooper. He brings up his 7th T20I fifty in style. Short in length and outside off, Ben camps back and spanks it down to long off this time for a powerful boundary. Netherlands continue to march.

FOUR! Smashed down the ground! O'Brien serves a length ball on middle, Ben lines up the bowler and clobbers it over the bowler's head. The long on fielder jogs across to his right just to pick up the ball from the rope.
6th T20I fifty for Max O'Dowd! A well-constructed knock by him. Gets a full ball on middle and leg and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Change in bowling. George O'Brien to have another go. He went for 16 runs in his first two overs.

Full toss on middle, Cooper looks to smash it down over mid on but it goes of the outer half of the bat. Travels to deep cover and the batsmen take two runs. 27 runs in the last two overs and 100 also comes up for Netherlands!
Tossed up delivery on off, O'Dowd drives it through mid off for a run.
Full on middle, Cooper drives it to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Cooper comes down the track and drives it to long off where the fielder does well to stop it with a dive. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up on off, O'Dowd drives it through mid off for a single.
SIX! First one of the game. Flighted delivery on middle, O'Dowd lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Janeiro Tucker is into the attack.
FOUR! Good shot. Flighted delivery on leg, Cooper sweeps it towards fine leg for the third boundary in this over. 14 runs have come from it as we reach the halfway mark.
Floated delivery on middle, O'Dowd flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nice shot. Second boundary of the over. Full toss on off, O'Dowd drives it through extra cover for a boundary.
Short delivery on off, O'Dowd cuts it to point.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cooper comes down the track and hits it towards mid on for a run.
FOUR! Boom! Quicker and fuller ball on middle and leg, Cooper goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly behind square leg for a cracking boundary.
Delray Rawlins is into the attack.
Full on middle, Cooper drives it to long on for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Cooper flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Tossed up on off, O'Dowd drives it through mid off for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, O'Dowd looks to sweep but misses it.

Appeal for an lbw! Flighted delivery, landing full, Max brings out the reverse sweep but fails to connect properly. They appeal but nothing from the umpire. Maybe, it pitched outside leg and also the on-air commentators feel that there was some bat. No replays shown.
Fires in a quicker one down the leg side, Cooper nudges it behind square leg for a run.

FOUR! Fine adjustment! Short in length and outside off, Cooper jumps out of the crease, doesn't quite reach the pitch of the ball but his hands have saved him. He reaches out and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR LEG BYES! Bowls a length delivery on leg, O'Dowd looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards fine leg for a boundary. Adding insult to injury.

DROPPED! Leverock has put down a caught and bowled chance. A slower one probably, full and around off, holding up a shade as well. Max is early into his shot and chips his drive back to the bowler. Kamau gets his hands in front of his face to attempt for the catch but it hits his palms and pops out. Bermuda need to take these half chances.
On a length on off, Cooper drives it through mid on for a run.
Full on middle, O'Dowd flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Third man has come up.
Length delivery on off, O'Dowd keeps it out on the leg side.
On a length on middle, O'Dowd flicks it to mid-wicket.
Kamau Leverock is back on. One over before this for him and it went for 12 runs. Needs to pull things back.
Tossed up on off, Cooper comes down the track and hits it back towards the bowler. A good diving stop by Trott in his followthrough.
Loopy delivery on off, O'Dowd plays it towards covers for a run.
Tossed up delivery on off, Cooper plays it towards point for a single.
Floated delivery on leg, O'Dowd flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, O'Dowd flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on off, Cooper punches it towards point and takes a run.
Rodney Trott is into the attack.

FOUR! Misfield inside the ring! Short in length and outside off, O'Dowd goes back and hammers it towards extra cover where the fielder dives but fails to make a clean stop. It hurries behind and the point fielder gives the chase. He comes second best. A boundary to close the Powerplay, Netherlands are 51/0! This is the first fifty opening partnership for them in this tournament, informs Ian Bishop on air.
Shortish and on middle, it's eased off the back foot to long on for another single.
Uses his feet to run down the track and then works it down to long on for a run.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to point.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Cooper goes deep inside the crease and forces it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, Max lunges and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Quicker one, flat and on middle, it's knocked down to the left of long on for a couple of runs. 11 from the over, a solid start by Netherlands.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Floated one, landing full around off, O'Dowd is forward in defense.
FOUR! Very poor bowling by Brangman. Not testing the Dutchmen enough. A long hop outside off and O'Dowd whacks it through extra cover.
FOUR! Pierces the gap this time. Short again by Brangman. Too much width and it's been slapped through the gap between point and cover-point. No stopping it.
Short delivery to start with. It's outside off, O'Dowd cuts but finds the point fielder.
Bowling change. Derrick Brangman is into the attack.
Tossed up delivery on off, O'Dowd punches it towards point for a run.
Straightaway uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball. Cooper lofts it down to long on for a run.

Nearly sneaks through off the inside edge to the stumps. An arm ball around off, from 'round the wicket, Cooper is cramped for room and somehow keeps it out off the inner edge to the on side. The keeper quickly gets to the ball.
Short delivery on off, Cooper cuts it to point.
Full on middle, O'Dowd drives it towards mid on for a run.
Tossed up on off, Cooper punches it towards point for a single.
Dion Stovell is into the attack.
Length delivery on middle, Cooper flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on off, Cooper cuts it to point.
On a good length on off, Cooper keeps it out.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Cooper looks to cut but misses it.
FOUR! Poor delivery from O'Brien. Full on leg, Cooper flicks it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, O'Dowd punches it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it. The batsmen get three runs.
On a length on off, O'Dowd plays it towards point for a single. 12 runs have come from the over.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Short delivery outside off, O'Dowd slaps it over covers for a boundary.
On a length and outside off, Cooper guides it towards third man for a single.
Full again and outside off, Cooper drives it through covers. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Full on off, O'Dowd drives it through covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on leg, O'Dowd flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, O'Dowd looks to flick but misses it.
Kamau Leverock to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Boom! A cracking shot. Spoils a good first over until now. Plenty of width on offer, short and wide, Cooper rocks back and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Inside edge! O'Brien pitches it up and outside off, O'Dowd tries to drive through covers but it takes the inside edge and runs wide of the stumps towards backward square leg. A single taken.
Slower one, full and on off, angling in, Max gets forward in defense.
Fuller and outside off, Cooper drives it superbly off his front foot. It's wide of mid off and he gets off the mark with a single.
Another back foot punch, this time in the gap on the leg side. A single is taken to open the account for Netherlands.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot but straight to point.
Wide! Slips a length ball down the leg side, an easy leave for O'Dowd.
Time to get going. The men concerned are out in the middle. Ben Cooper and Max O'Dowd are the openers for Netherlands. George O'Brien to bowl the first over. Here we go...

Pitch report - One part of the stadium is really short and the batsmen would like to target that. Towards the longer side, there are plenty of chances for 2s and 3s. It's a fresh pitch but it has similar features like the last few games. It would provide good value for shots. Par score here is 180.

Bermuda skipper, Rodney Trott says that they were looking to have a hit first up but now will look to bowl well. Wants to do well today as a team. Tells that there might be a change in their batting order. Informs about the three changes - Janeiro Tucker, Deunte Darrell and Derrick Brangman are in the XI.

Netherlands skipper, Pieter Seelaar says that they want to bat as that's the way to go in this tournament. Feels that their batting has not been as free-flowing as they would have liked and hopes to do well this time. Hopes to win 5 out of 6 and tells that they are focusing on winning the match more than on their net run-rate. Informs about the couple of changes - Shane Snater and Fred Klaassen are in the XI.

Bermuda (Playing XI) - Dion Stovell, Oronde Bascome, Allan Douglas, Delray Rawlins, Janeiro Tucker (IN FOR TERRYN FRAY), Deunte Darrell (IN FOR ONAIS BASCOME), Kamau Leverock, Okera Bascome (WK), Rodney Trott (C), Derrick Brangman (IN FOR SINCLAIR SMITH), George O'Brien.

Netherlands (Playing XI) - Ben Cooper, Max O'Dowd, Colin Ackermann, Ryan ten Doeschate, Pieter Seelaar (C), Roelof van der Merwe, Scott Edwards (WK), Timm van der Gugten, Shane Snater (IN FOR BRANDON GLOVER), Fred Klaassen (IN FOR TOBIAS VISEE), Paul van Meekeren.
Toss - Pieter Seelaar comes out trumps at the toss and he has decided that NETHERLANDS WILL BAT!

Warm welcome everyone for Match 36 of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier between Bermuda and Netherlands in Dubai. The Dutch team is coming off a defeat in their last match against PNG and that also halted their 3-match winning streak. With two games left, the Netherlands side would hope to win both and keep their hopes alive for straight qualification to the first group stage of the 2020 ICC T20 World Cup. Bermuda, on the other hand, are the team yet to open their account and have got knocked out already. They would be aiming to sign off on a high and be the party-poopers for the Orange team. Can they overpower the mighty Netherlands? Stay with us to find out...
